component.name: OVRLEY
component.summary: Turn telemetry into customizable video overlays

description.p: OVRLEY turns telemetry from activities, flights, motorsports and cameras into fully customizable overlays for your videos. Design the overlay in a visual editor, then let the native rendering engine export it.

ul.li: Import FIT, GPX, SRT, IGC, CSV and VBO files, or telemetry embedded in supported camera videos
Drag-and-drop editor with live preview, reusable templates and undo/redo
More than 40 widgets and animated gauges for speed, heart rate, power, G-force, lap times, maps and more
Export transparent overlays for editors such as DaVinci Resolve, or final video with the overlay baked in
Hardware-accelerated export with NVIDIA NVENC and VAAPI (Intel and AMD)
Works fully offline: all processing happens on your computer
